target.title: docs: keep feature index capability-focused
target.body:
## Summary

- Make the Features landing page explicitly capability-focused.
- Remove the duplicated Providers catalog and provider deep-dive list from `docs/features/README.md`.
- Point readers to the canonical first-class Provider Reference for provider choice, adapter implementation, and per-provider behavior.
- Preserve all existing provider and feature document URLs; this only cleans up the landing-page information architecture.

## Why

The latest docs site now has a first-class **Providers** section and a canonical provider reference, but `/features/` still repeated a full Providers section and a list of provider-specific deep dives. That made the two top-level sections overlap and obscured the distinction between capability contracts and provider-specific behavior.

## User impact

The Features page now answers “what can Crabbox do?” without duplicating “where can it run?”. Readers looking for a provider are directed to the searchable provider reference instead.

## Validation

- Branch created from current upstream `main` (`6da7760693a820c53434b4774077f526d362c136`).
- Compared the branch against that base: one commit, one documentation file, no unrelated changes.
- Confirmed the new `../providers/README.md` target exists and all retained feature links are unchanged.

Generated site output is not committed.
